+        shutil.copytree(os.path.join(FIX, "run", "transcripts"), os.path.join(tmp, "t"))

+        out = {}

+            words = json.load(open(os.path.join(tmp, "t", f"{seg['video_id']}.json")))["words"]

+        self.assertTrue(r["lock_diff_reported"], r)
+
